column3: A string designed to play E1 (41 Hz) on a bass guitar, steel cored with three steel windings; make not named
column4: Stretched between two heavy rigid bridges 750 mm apart on a monochord; tension varied so that the transverse fundamental took 13 values from 30 to 60 Hz; flexural rigidity measured for static loads; torsional stiffness measured in situ at normal tension with a torsional pendulum; the first two torsional resonances measured in separate experiments at two tensions
column5: The paper says the flexural rigidity may increase with frequency; it attributes the tension dependence of the torsional frequencies possibly to forces between the windings and notes a little hysteresis related to windings slipping over the bridge; no temperature or humidity stated
